responsibility: Implements the generic process-execution and cleanup support shared by collect2-style helper programs such as collect2 and lto-wrapper. This file owns the common notice/fatal-signal handling, temporary response-file creation for @file command passing, pex-based subprocess launching and waiting, verbose/debug command echoing, and one-shot cleanup dispatch through the tool-specific tool_cleanup hook, providing the reusable runtime substrate rather than any collect2-specific symbol scanning or driver policy.
same_name_distinction: This is the implementation file in the collect-utils pair: it provides the actual shared runtime for collect2-style helper tools, including notice/fatal-signal handling, pex-based subprocess execution and waiting, response-file creation, and cleanup dispatch via tool_cleanup. Unlike gcc/collect-utils.h, it does not just declare the tool contract and utility entry points; it executes them.
